assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
The dizziness episodes are concerning for potential arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered for this patient.
The telemetry is intended to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The monitoring is over an extended monitoring period.
The service addresses the clinical need defined by diagnosis code I34.0.
The service addresses the clinical need defined by diagnosis code R42.
